title: Transactional adminlets: undo checkpoints, replayable dry-run, and safety preflight linter
creator: Amina Patel
description: Introduce a transaction-first model for admin utilities ("adminlets") that enables non-destructive checkpoints, automatic undo, and replayable dry-runs with provenance. This ticket covers the core runtime primitives, preflight linter, telemetry hooks, and an integration plan for runbooks-as-tasks so support flows can adopt transactional semantics without changing their interfaces.
technical_design_notes:
Goals:
- Provide an idempotent transaction canvas that records state diffs as immutable checkpoints (staging ledger).
- Support lightweight 'undolets' which roll back to named checkpoints or apply compensating actions.
- Dry-run mode that executes adminlets against a sandboxed ledger and produces a provenance bundle for auditing.
- A preflight safety linter that runs static checks + model of side effects to surface unsafe sequences (e.g., multi-step credential rotation without rollback).
Implementation outline:
1) Ledger shim: append-only JSONL ledger stored alongside run metadata (GCS/KV) with TID, op, before/after hashes, author, timestamp.
2) Checkpoint primitives: begin_checkpoint(name), commit_checkpoint(), rollback_to(name).
3) Undolets: register compensating step for destructive ops; fallback if compensating action not available.
4) Dry-run harness: invoke adminlet in sandbox mode with config 'sandbox=true' and produce provenance bundle (ledger + diffs + telemetry snapshot).
5) Preflight linter: rule engine (YAML rules) + deterministic effect model; run during CI and at runtime preflight.
6) Runtime integration: runbooks-as-tasks engine should call into transaction canvas; expose 'checkpoint' step type in task graph.
7) Telemetry: emit tokenized events to Console: adminlet.start/commit/rollback/dryrun, checkpoint.created, preflight.warning; correlate with trace_id and user identity for audit.
Security notes: KMS required for ledger encryption; RBAC gating for commit/rollback operations.
Compatibility: maintain backward-compatible adminlet API; default behavior is non-transactional until opt-in.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Implement ledger shim and checkpoint primitives with end-to-end unit tests.
2) Dry-run mode runs a sample adminlet (credential-rotate-demo) and produces a provenance bundle validated by the linter.
3) Preflight linter runs in CI and flags at least three sample unsafe patterns.
4) Runbooks-as-tasks integration: add 'checkpoint' node type and update two existing support playbooks to use transactional checkpoints.
5) Telemetry events visible in Console dashboard with linkable trace IDs.
6) Security review completed and KMS integration demonstrated in staging.
